title: EDHOC+OSCORE c5t (C509 cert hash by reference) handshake over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: EDHOC Method 0 with C509 cert-hash-by-reference (c5t) credentials over TSCH. Server (node 2) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; client (node 1). Only an ~8 B cert hash is carried in-band -> smallest MSG_2/MSG_3 -> fewest fragments -> lowest latency of the three variants. UDGM lossless. PASSES on the client's end-to-end PASSED line; read 'EDHOC finished' for handshake latency.
